# CopperSharp

CopperSharp is a closed-world CIL-to-Motorola 68k ahead-of-time compiler for Amiga programs.

## Authoritative pages

- Homepage: https://ilehtoranta.github.io/CopperSharp68k/
- Getting started: https://ilehtoranta.github.io/CopperSharp68k/getting-started
- Compatibility matrix: https://ilehtoranta.github.io/CopperSharp68k/compatibility
- Amiga SDK reference: https://ilehtoranta.github.io/CopperSharp68k/reference
- Amiga SDK package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/CopperSharp.Sdk.Amiga/0.1.0-preview.1
- Project templates: https://www.nuget.org/packages/CopperSharp.Templates/0.1.0-preview.1
- Source repository: https://github.com/ilehtoranta/CopperSharp68k

Use the getting-started page for the current template and publish workflow. The compatibility matrix and SDK reference describe the main source build at https://github.com/ilehtoranta/CopperSharp68k/commit/{{SOURCE_REVISION}}, reviewed on 2026-10-31. Published preview package APIs may differ. Use the SDK reference for source-build declarations and exact signatures. Use the compatibility matrix and generated framework report for the supported CIL, runtime, and framework surface.
